question_om: Mammaaksi "Intalti dubraa siree qaraatii, waan niin qaba ja'anii abdatan hin qabdu" maal jechuudha?
question_en: What does the proverb "Intalti dubraa siree qaraatii, waan niin qaba ja'anii abdatan hin qabdu" mean?
answer_om: Akkuma sireen hundee bishingaarraa (qaraarraa) tolfamte laaftuu fi yeroo gabaabaa qofa turtee dhumattu, intalli dubraas guddannaan heerumtee gara mana dhiirsaatti waan deemtuuf qabeenya dhaabbataa mana abbaatti hafu miti; heerumtee deemuu ishee agarsiisa
answer_en: Just as a bed constructed from lightweight sorghum roots/stalks (siree qaraa) is fragile, temporary, and lacks durability, an unmarried maiden is not a permanent domestic fixture in her parents' home, for she will inevitably marry and depart for her husband's clan

question_om: Mammaaksi "Doobbaan, abbaa dhale dire" maal jechuudha?
question_en: What does the proverb "Doobbaan, abbaa dhale dire" mean?
answer_om: Loon gaafa dhedheeraa qabu (Doobbaan) isa abbaan kunuunsee guddise deebi'ee abbuma isa guddise sana gaafaan waraanee akka madeessuutti, namni ofii guddifatan, kunuunsanii fi amanan tokko humna erga horatee booda garagalee nama tola isaaf oole sanarratti gantummaa fi miidhaa raawwachuu ceepha'a

answer_en: The hornless cow drinks water from right beneath the sprawling horns of the long-horned cow; someone lacking weapons or brute force uses clever positioning, humility, and tact to secure sustenance and thrive under the very span of the mighty

proverb_ao: Addunyaan wasaasaadha
question_om: Mammaaksi "Addunyaan wasaasaadha" maal jechuudha?
question_en: What does the proverb "Addunyaan wasaasaadha" mean?
answer_om: Akkuma wasaasaan reeffa namaa tokko baattee awwaala geessitee gattee deebitee kan biraa eeggattu, addunyaan kunis nama hundumaa dabaree dabareedhaan gara du'aatti baatti malee namuu irratti hin hafu; jireenyi addunyaa kan yerooti malee qabeenya dhaabbataa miti
answer_en: Just as a funeral bier (wasaasaa) carries one corpse to the grave, unloads it, and returns to carry the next, this mortal world is merely a vehicle steadily carrying each human being by turn toward death; earthly existence belongs permanently to no one
theme_en: Transience of Worldly Life and Inevitable Death

answer_en: The mother of a valiant warrior enjoys great communal reverence and protection because of her son's courage: if she goes missing, the entire community mobilizes a search for her, and when she dies, she receives an honorable, well-attended burial. A child's valor shields and honors his mother in both life and death

It condemns human greed and social cruelty during seasons of prosperity.
